translator.title: AI Subtitle Translation
translator.description: Supports multi-language translation of LRC/SRT subtitles, with bilingual or target-only output.

fields.upload_tips: Click to upload or drag files here
fields.output_mode_source_hint: Each file outputs to its source directory
fields.concurrent_slices_hint: When enabled, multiple slices of a single task will request the API concurrently, significantly improving translation speed but increasing burst concurrency

errors.duplicate_file: File {file} already exists, skipping duplicate addition
errors.path_selection_failed: Path selection failed, please try again
errors.please_select_output_url: Please select the output URL first
errors.source_path_missing: Cannot read source file path. Use a custom output directory.

token_stats.title: Token Consumption Estimate
token_stats.cost_tooltip: This is only an estimate. Actual billing includes both input and output tokens, and output tokens cannot be known exactly before translation. Longer translations may cost more than estimated; final billing depends on the model provider.

schedule.title: Scheduled Start
schedule.prevent_sleep_note: Prevents idle sleep only; manual sleep or lid close is not blocked
schedule.time_reached_start: Scheduled time reached, starting all tasks
schedule.time_reached_no_tasks: Scheduled time reached, but no tasks to start

new_task_config.title: New Task Configuration
new_task_config.note: Current slice mode applies to newly added tasks. Existing tasks keep their creation-time configuration.

recovery.title: Recover Historical Tasks
recovery.source_unavailable_hint: Source file unavailable or changed. Translation will continue using original fragments from the recovery manifest.
recovery.confirm_add_from_manifest_desc: Source file is unavailable or changed. Translation will continue using original fragment data stored in the recovery manifest.

tour.config_content: Configure translation parameters in the left panel, including languages, output format, segmentation mode, and output path. All settings are saved automatically and restored the next time you open the tool.
tour.lang_content: Set the source and target languages for the subtitles. Translation is available between Japanese, English, Chinese, and many other languages.
tour.output_mode_content: “Bilingual” keeps the original text and appends the translation, while “Target only” outputs only the translation.
tour.slice_content: Subtitles are split according to the selected strategy and sent to the AI for translation segment by segment. Choose standard, fine-grained, or custom character-count segmentation.
tour.output_path_content: Choose where to save translated files: a custom folder or the source subtitle file’s folder.
tour.schedule_content: Set translation to start automatically at a specific time, which is useful for batch processing overnight or during idle periods.
tour.upload_content: Drag .lrc or .srt subtitle files here, or click to select files. You can add multiple files at once.
tour.queue_content: All added translation tasks appear here. You can check progress, edit settings, retry failed tasks, or delete tasks.
tour.start_content: Click to start all pending translation tasks. When they finish, you can find the result files in the output path.

local_transcriber.title: Local Subtitle Transcriber
local_transcriber.description: Use an installed on-device model to transcribe audio and video files into SRT subtitles in batches.

file.title: Add audio or video
file.description: Drop media files here or select them from your device, up to {{max}} per batch

resources.title: Managed resources
resources.empty: No managed resources are available for this platform.

import.title: Import compatible model
import.description: Select the GGML model file matching the built-in manifest. FusionKit verifies its size, hash, and CPU load before committing it.
import.copy_hint: The selected file is kept after a verified copy is installed.
import.move_hint: The selected file is removed only after the verified model is committed safely.

delete.title: Delete managed resource?
delete.description: {{name}} will be removed from FusionKit's managed storage. You can install it again later.

readiness.environment_unavailable: The local runtime status could not be read.
readiness.runtime_unavailable: The local transcription runtime or CPU backend is unavailable.
readiness.session_unavailable: The task session is not ready. Check the environment again.
readiness.model_required: An installed, ready local model is required.
readiness.backend_preview_loading: Resolving the execution backend for the selected model.
readiness.backend_preview_unavailable: The execution backend for the selected model could not be verified. Check the local environment again.
readiness.file_required: Select at least one audio or video file.

queue.title: Task queue
queue.empty_description: Submitted files will appear here in batches with task status and results.

cpu_retry.title: Retry this transcription on CPU?
cpu_retry.description: The GPU task for {{name}} failed. FusionKit will retain that generation and create a new CPU generation, which may run considerably slower.

blocked.title: Recovery state unavailable
blocked.description: FusionKit could not read the recovery state. Existing files were left unchanged.

unavailable.title: Output recovery unavailable
unavailable.description: The required recovery component is unavailable. Existing files were left unchanged.

error.recovery_pending: Recovery is not complete. Choose the original output folder and try again.
error.directory_authorization_required: Choose the original output folder to continue recovery.
error.persistence_failed: Recovery state could not be saved safely. Try again later.
error.invalid_request: This recovery item changed. Refresh and try again.
error.invalid_state: This recovery item cannot be processed now. Refresh and try again.
error.invalid_result: The recovery result could not be confirmed. The files remain protected.
error.generic: Recovery could not be completed. Try again later.

extractor.title: Subtitle Language Extraction
extractor.description: Extract text lines of a specified language from bilingual LRC/SRT subtitles while preserving format and timestamps.

fields.output_mode_source_hint: Each file outputs to its source directory
fields.upload_tips: Click or drag LRC/SRT files here

errors.path_selection_failed: Path selection failed, please try again
errors.please_select_output_url: Please select the output directory first
errors.source_path_missing: Cannot read source file path. Use a custom output directory.

tour.config_content: Set extraction parameters in the left panel, including the language to keep, output path, and conflict policy. Settings are saved automatically.
tour.keep_content: Choose the language to keep from bilingual subtitles. The tool automatically identifies and extracts the lines in that language.
tour.output_content: Choose where to save extracted files: a custom folder or the source file’s folder.
tour.upload_content: Drag bilingual .lrc or .srt subtitle files here, or click to select files. You can add multiple files at once.
tour.queue_content: Added extraction tasks appear here. You can check their status, edit settings, or delete tasks.
tour.start_content: Click to start all pending extraction tasks. When they finish, you can find the monolingual result files in the output path.

converter.title: Subtitle Format Converter
converter.description: Convert between LRC, SRT, and VTT subtitle formats.

fields.duration_hint: Used only when converting from LRC to SRT/VTT for subtitles without end time
fields.strip_media_ext_hint: If the input name is like xxx.wav.vtt, the output will be xxx.lrc (instead of xxx.wav.lrc)
fields.output_mode_source_hint: Each file outputs to its source directory
fields.upload_tips: Click or drag LRC/SRT/VTT files here

errors.path_selection_failed: Path selection failed, please try again
errors.please_select_output_url: Please select the output directory first
errors.source_path_missing: Cannot read source file path. Use a custom output directory.

tour.config_content: Set conversion parameters in the left panel, including target format, default duration, and output path. Settings are saved automatically.
tour.format_content: Choose the target subtitle format: LRC (lyrics), SRT (general-purpose subtitles), or VTT (web subtitles).
tour.output_content: Choose where to save converted files: a custom folder or the source file’s folder.
tour.upload_content: Drag .lrc, .srt, or .vtt subtitle files here, or click to select files. You can add multiple files at once.
tour.queue_content: Added conversion tasks appear here. You can check their status, edit settings, or delete tasks.
tour.start_content: Click to start all pending conversion tasks. When they finish, you can find the result files in the output path.
